title: Area Minimization Among Group-Invariant Planar Convex Bodies of Constant Width
summary: The classical Blaschke--Lebesgue theorem identifies the Reuleaux triangle as the planar convex body of constant width with minimum area. We investigate this extremal problem under prescribed symmetry constraints. Specifically, we classify the minimum-area convex bodies of constant width that are invariant under a finite group $G$ of isometries of $\mathbb{R}^2$ fixing the origin. For the exceptional reflection group $D_1$, the minimizers are precisely the Reuleaux triangles invariant under the prescribed reflection.
